citations.quote: Vice President Sara Duterte's younger brother, Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte, has been subpoenaed to testify next week in the former's Senate impeachment trial.
The Senate impeachment court ordered Duterte to appear on Sept. 23, along with lawyer Gary Samonte and Police Major Jericho Sangalang.
Senate impeachment court subpoenaed Davao City Mayor Sebastian "Baste" Duterte to testify Sept. 23 in Vice President Sara Duterte's trial, with his appearance mandatory.
The Senate impeachment court on Wednesday issued a subpoena to Davao City Mayor Sebastian "Baste" Duterte, directing him to appear at the impeachment trial of his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte.

Duterte was among the individuals subpoenaed to appear on September 23, including Gerardo del Rosario, director of the company registration and monitoring department of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).

Nakatakdang padalhan ng Senate Impeachment Court ng subpoena si Davao City Mayor Sebastian "Baste" Duterte sang-ayon sa hiling ng Prosecution panel para dumalo sa impeachment trial ng kapatid niyang si Vice President Sara Duterte sa Setyembre 23.

MANILA – Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte and four others have been ordered to appear before the Senate impeachment court as the prosecution shifts to government and corporate records tied to Vice President Sara Duterte, with the Sept. 23 vote on the disputed conviction threshold forcing adjustments in the witness calendar...

MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s brother, Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte, has been summoned by the Senate impeachment court as a witness sought by the prosecution in the case over her alleged unexplained wealth.

The court’s presiding officer, Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero, issued a subpoena on Wednesday for the younger Duterte to appear on Sept. 23 to be questioned about Article 2 of the impeachment complaint.
"In regard to Mayor Sebastian Duterte, Atty. Gary Samonte, and Police Maj. Jericson Sangalang, let the subpoena be issued only for Sept. 23," Escudero said.
The impeachment court on Wednesday, September 16, granted the prosecution’s request to compel the attendance of the younger Duterte on September 23.
At the end of Wednesday’s impeachment trial, Presiding Officer and Senator-judge Francis Escudero issued the subpoena for Baste Duterte

At the end of Wednesday’s impeachment trial, Presiding Officer and Senator-judge Francis Escudero issued the subpoena for Duterte, Atty. Gerardo del Rosario, of the Securities and Exchange Commission, and other individuals.

The Senate impeachment court earlier confirmed that the Davao City mayor would be summoned to court next week to answer allegations about the government contracts that his sister’s companies supposedly won from the local government of their bailiwick Davao.

"In regard to Mayor Sebastian Duterte, Atty. Gary Samonte, and Police Major Jerickson Sangalang, let the subpoena be issued only for September 23. However, on September 22, depending on where we are with respect to the three witnesses, we shall announce if we will be withdrawing that subpoena and simply issue a new one," he added.

Escudero ordered the subpoenas for Sebastian Duterte, Samonte and Sangalang for Sept. 23, but said the court may withdraw and reissue them for the following week or later depending on the pace of the first three witnesses.

Presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero on Wednesday granted new subpoenas for Civil Service Commission (CSC) Assistant Commissioner Ariel Ronquillo, Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) Division Chief Rendell Sopeña, Duterte, lawyer Gary Samonte and Police Major Jerrickson Sangalang.
He is tentatively scheduled to appear before the impeachment court on Sept. 23, although the date may still change as other witnesses are set to testify ahead of him.

"However, on Sept. 22, depending on where we are with respect to the three witnesses, we shall announce if we will be withdrawing that subpoena and simply issue a new one for the following week or the week thereafter so as not to waste their time given that they are all officials performing duties in connection with their functions," he added.
In regard to Mayor Sebastian Duterte, Atty. Gary Samonte, and P/Maj.
